candidate_decisions.summary: Output "arn" indexes the conditional queue without try, so it fails when create is false.
candidate_decisions.suggested_fix: Wrap the value of `output "arn"` in `outputs.tf` in `try(aws_sqs_queue.this[0].arn, null)`.

findings.summary: The IAM blocks are split around the queue resource.
findings.suggested_fix: Move `resource "aws_iam_role" "this"` in `main.tf` next to the other IAM blocks.
